market.question: Will Tampa Bay Rays vs Milwaukee Brewers be the 2026 World Series matchup?
market.ruleSummary: YES when Tampa Bay is the officially determined ALCS champion and Milwaukee is the officially determined NLCS champion for 2026. Official MLB designation by another method also counts. An impossible listed pairing resolves NO. Cancellation before both champions or missing determination by 2026-11-03 23:59 ET resolves listed pairings NO. Subsequent World Series changes do not alter the matchup outcome.
market.sources: Official MLB information, or consensus of credible reporting.
